paragraphs.label: Mục đích
paragraphs.text:
Dear Mr Green,

I am writing to complain about a neighbourhood walking event, which I attended at the park entrance last week. I had expected a practical session about walking as a daily habit, but several parts of the advertised programme were not provided.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu dịch vụ, thời điểm và sự không hài lòng.

paragraphs.label: Vấn đề đầu
paragraphs.text: The notice stated that we would explore a short local route and note useful improvements. However, most of the session was a general presentation, and there was almost no time for practice. This was disappointing because I had joined specifically to understand how a useful route to a shop or bus stop can make walking part of a journey rather than an extra task.
paragraphs.noteVi: So sánh điều quảng cáo và trải nghiệm thực tế.

paragraphs.label: Vấn đề tiếp
paragraphs.text: In addition, the session began forty minutes late without any explanation. I had brought comfortable walking shoes and arranged my day around the advertised starting time, so the delay caused unnecessary inconvenience. Several questions also remained unanswered when the centre closed.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chi tiết có thể xử lý, không công kích người nhận.

paragraphs.label: Yêu cầu và kết
paragraphs.text:
I would like you to offer a replacement practical session at no additional cost, or a partial refund if this is not possible. Please explain how you intend to resolve the matter.

Thank you for taking the time to read my letter. Please let me know if you need any further information. I look forward to your reply.

Yours sincerely,
Minh Nguyen
paragraphs.noteVi: Yêu cầu tương xứng và chờ phản hồi.
